prompt: A page where members of our pottery studio can book time in the shared kilns. Just the booking part, not the whole website. One self-contained HTML file, inline CSS, system fonts, no external assets.
pick_rule: Chosen as the task with the largest judged difference in favor of the skill among tasks where the skill loaded.

images.alt: Dark kiln booking page: steps for kiln, firing type and day, a grid of two weeks with Mondays dimmed, and a Your booking summary with a Confirm booking button while load-in and shelves are still blank.

Light kiln booking page: steps for kiln, firing type and the next 14 days, two days marked No windows, and a Your upcoming bookings panel with an empty state explaining that a booking will appear there and can be cancelled.
